name: xml-and-web-services
description: Comprehensive learning repository for XML and modern web services. Peer-created learning resource with Python Jupyter notebooks and JavaScript/Node.js examples.
author: Community Contributors

dependencies.axios: HTTP client library (used as alternative to Fetch API)
dependencies.graphql: Core GraphQL library for schema building

optionalDependencies.apollo-server: GraphQL server framework - Install for Week 11
optionalDependencies.apollo-client: GraphQL client for React - Install for Week 11 browser examples
optionalDependencies.express: Web framework - Install for REST/GraphQL servers
optionalDependencies.jsonwebtoken: JWT token creation/verification - Install for Week 13

installation.basic: npm install - Installs only core dependencies (Fetch API built-in)
installation.rest: npm install axios - For REST examples
installation.graphql: npm install apollo-server graphql - For GraphQL server
installation.security: npm install jsonwebtoken bcryptjs - For authentication
installation.oauth: npm install passport passport-github express-session - For OAuth
installation.all: npm install --save-optional - Installs all optional packages
